title: CSV Validator – Check CSV Files for Errors | OpenAnyDoc
description: CSV validator: check a CSV file's delimiter, encoding, line endings and row lengths, find unclosed quotes and mixed types, then fix them. No upload.
heading: CSV Validator: Find and Fix CSV Errors
subtitle: Drop a CSV file for a report on its format and every problem by row; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Validate a CSV file in your browser: it opens on the Issues panel with a file report (delimiter, encoding, byte order mark, line endings, rows and columns) and every parse problem with its row, such as unclosed quotes or rows with more or fewer fields than the header. Health checks flag mixed types, extra spaces and repeated rows, with one-click fixes. Nothing is uploaded.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is opened by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: One-click fixes
features.text: Trim spaces at either end of cells or remove repeated rows in one click, then download the fixed file.

features.title: Works offline
features.text: Once this page has loaded, it keeps working without an internet connection.

stepsTitle: How it works: validate a CSV file

steps.title: Open your CSV
steps.text: Drop a .csv file, choose it, paste CSV into the paste box, or try one of the samples.

steps.title: Read the file report
steps.text: See the detected delimiter, the encoding, whether there is a byte order mark, the line endings, and the row and column counts.

steps.title: Go through the issues
steps.text: Each parse problem is listed with its row, followed by the health checks: mixed types, spaces at the ends of cells and repeated rows.

steps.title: Fix and download
steps.text: Edit cells in place, use Trim or Remove for the health checks, then download the fixed file.

handles: Delimiter: detected from the file and shown in the report.
Encoding: UTF-8, UTF-16, or, when the file is not valid UTF-8, Windows-1256 (Arabic) or Windows-1252 (Western European); the byte order mark is reported.
Parse problems: unclosed quotes, and rows with more or fewer fields than the header, each with its row.
Health checks: mixed types in a column, spaces at either end of cells, repeated rows.
limits: It checks the file's structure and contents, not a schema: there are no rules for required columns or allowed values.
Mixed types are flagged for columns that are mostly numbers or dates with a few other values.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your browser reads and checks the file on your device; nothing is sent to a server.

faq.question: What does the CSV validator check?
faq.answer: The format (delimiter, encoding, byte order mark, line endings, rows and columns), parse problems such as unclosed quotes and rows of the wrong length, and health checks for mixed types, extra spaces and repeated rows.

faq.question: Why does a row have more fields than the header?
faq.answer: Usually a cell holds the delimiter without quotes around it, or a quote is left open. The issue shows the row, so you can find the cell and fix it.

faq.question: How is the encoding detected?
faq.answer: The file is read as UTF-8, or UTF-16 when it starts with that byte order mark. When it is not valid UTF-8, it is read as Windows-1256, common in older Arabic files, or as Windows-1252 when its letters look Western European, such as ä, é or ñ.

faq.question: Can I fix the problems here?
faq.answer: Yes. Edit any cell in place, trim spaces or remove repeated rows in one click, undo if needed, and download the fixed file.

faq.question: Can I validate a CSV against a schema?
faq.answer: No. There are no rules for required columns, value formats or allowed values; it checks the file's structure and its contents.

faq.question: How do I check a CSV file for errors?
faq.answer: Open the CSV and read its report: the delimiter, encoding and row and column counts, every row that breaks the format, such as one with too many fields, then mixed types, extra spaces and repeated rows. OpenAnyDoc checks it in your browser without uploading it, and you can fix cells in place and download the fixed file.
